title: MacTech CUI Vault — Outstanding-36 Canonical Snapshot
description: Single source of truth for the 74-adjudicated / 36-outstanding split for a CUI Vault customer (Win 2025 Datacenter on Azure Government, signed MacTech governance bundle, OS evidence ingested). Reconciled from MacTech_CUI_Vault_Control_Intelligence_Matrix.xlsx and src/data/cmmc/control-intelligence.ts with explicit C3PAO-defensible disposition overrides.

adjudicated_breakdown.rationale: Implemented = auto-closed by OS Collector evidence + signed MacTech governance bundle. Inherited = full 3.10 Physical Protection family, fully provided by Azure Government FedRAMP High.

outstanding_breakdown.rationale: Partial = needs both technical evidence AND a register entry / governance artifact. N/A = needs a one-time customer attestation that the control does not apply in their environment.

inherited_controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
inherited_controls.rationale: Datacenter physical access fully managed by Microsoft.

inherited_controls.title: Physical Access Control
inherited_controls.rationale: Datacenter physical access fully managed by Microsoft.

inherited_controls.title: Visitor Records
inherited_controls.source: Azure Government FedRAMP High + customer attestation
inherited_controls.rationale: Datacenter visitor records maintained by Microsoft. C3PAO-defensible inheritance requires customer attestation: 'no on-site visitors with CUI access at our offices' OR signed customer-side visitor log register (MAC-SOP-249).

inherited_controls.title: Physical Access Logs
inherited_controls.rationale: Datacenter physical access logs maintained by Microsoft.

inherited_controls.title: Physical Access Monitoring
inherited_controls.rationale: Datacenter monitoring (CCTV, security personnel) provided by Microsoft.

inherited_controls.title: Alternate Work Site
inherited_controls.source: Azure Government FedRAMP High + customer attestation
inherited_controls.rationale: C3PAO-defensible inheritance requires customer attestation: 'no telework / no alternate work sites where CUI is accessed' OR sign the Remote Work Authorization Policy and maintain the corresponding register.

not_applicable_controls.title: Wireless Access Authorization
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No wireless infrastructure within the CUI boundary. Wired LAN / Azure Bastion only.

not_applicable_controls.title: Wireless Access Protection
not_applicable_controls.rationale: Same as 3.1.16. No wireless infrastructure to protect.

not_applicable_controls.title: Equipment Sanitization
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No physical equipment in the CUI boundary. Disposal handled via Azure-managed deletion (FedRAMP-validated).

not_applicable_controls.title: Maintenance Tools
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No on-prem maintenance permitted. All maintenance via Azure PIM-elevated cloud admins; no physical tools transit the boundary.

not_applicable_controls.title: Maintenance Personnel
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No third-party maintenance personnel. All maintenance performed by org-internal admins via Azure PIM.

not_applicable_controls.title: Media Marking
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No physical media. All CUI is digital with metadata tagging at the file/blob layer.

not_applicable_controls.title: Media Accountability
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No physical media transport. All CUI access is via Azure Bastion → managed Windows endpoint.

not_applicable_controls.title: Split Tunneling Prohibition
not_applicable_controls.rationale: VPN client policy forbids split tunneling. All traffic routes through Azure Bastion to the enclave.

not_applicable_controls.title: Collaborative Device Prohibition
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No collaborative computing devices (smart TVs, video conferencing systems, interactive whiteboards) within the CUI boundary.

not_applicable_controls.title: VoIP Protection
not_applicable_controls.rationale: No VoIP infrastructure within the CUI boundary. CUI not transmitted via voice.

architecture_static_disposition_override.reason: No physical media in the CUI Vault architecture; Azure-managed deletion handles disposal.
No on-prem maintenance permitted in the CUI Vault architecture; all maintenance via Azure PIM.
No third-party maintenance personnel; all maintenance performed by org-internal admins via Azure PIM.
No physical media to mark; CUI is digital with metadata tagging at the file/blob layer.
No physical media transport; all CUI access via Azure Bastion.
VPN client policy forbids split tunneling; control does not apply.
Mobile devices technically blocked via Entra Conditional Access (compliant Windows devices only) — this is an active technical control, not 'doesn't apply'.
Same as 3.1.18: mobile-device data protection enforced via managed-device-only access policy.

customer_attested_inherited.reason: Inheritance is conditional on customer attestation that no on-site visitors have CUI access at customer offices. If the customer cannot attest, control reverts to PARTIAL with a customer-side visitor log register.
Inheritance is conditional on customer attestation that no telework or alternate work sites exist. If the customer cannot attest, control reverts to PARTIAL with a Remote Work Authorization Register.
